key_features_subtitle: A closer look at what Ascurix Desktop handles for you every day.
kf_workspace_desc: At the core of Ascurix Desktop is a unified, highly optimized environment designed to bring all your legal and business operations into a single point of control. By eliminating scattered windows and fragmented apps, it enables seamless multitasking with zero friction.
kf_workspace_bullet_1: One dashboard for cases, documents, search, and email
kf_workspace_bullet_2: Local-first storage — everything stays on your own disk
kf_workspace_bullet_3: Zero-friction navigation between templates, search, and settings
kf_workspace_row1_desc: Case records, communication history, document templates, and preferences in one dashboard.
kf_workspace_row2_desc: Cycle between summaries, search results, and email sync settings without losing context.
kf_workspace_row3_desc: Indexed text, FTS5 structures, and API credentials remain stored securely on your disk.
kf_workspace_row4_desc: Generate pleadings, letters, and notices dynamically from case properties.
kf_casemgmt_desc: Streamline the lifecycle of your client matters. Ascurix Desktop lets you organize folders, files, and correspondences under specific case files, making sure you always have contextual information at your fingertips.
kf_casemgmt_bullet_1: Case codes, client metadata, and notes in one structured file
kf_casemgmt_bullet_2: Link documents, templates, and contracts to a case automatically
kf_casemgmt_bullet_3: Track status workflows and priority tags at a glance
kf_casemgmt_alt: Active cases tracking and status badges
kf_casemgmt_row1_desc: Define case codes and client metadata, and link documents directly to a centralized file structure.
kf_casemgmt_row2_desc: Track workflows (Active, In Review, Closed) and assign priority tags to follow up instantly.
kf_indexing_desc: Ascurix Desktop uses cutting-edge LLMs (such as Anthropic Claude) to analyze your documentation. Instead of manually reviewing files to extract key terms or dates, the system processes them in the background to automatically build a structured profile.
kf_indexing_bullet_1: File ingestion — PDF, Word (.docx), Excel (.xlsx), and text
kf_indexing_bullet_2: AI analysis — extracts summaries, topics, and critical dates
kf_indexing_bullet_3: Index persistence — structured attributes saved for instant queries
kf_indexing_row1_desc: Every document gets a concise, AI-drafted summary — understand a 50-page contract in seconds.
kf_indexing_row2_desc: Automatically identify filing dates, authors, counterparty details, and legal topics.
kf_search_desc: Locate document segments, quotes, or metadata fields in milliseconds. Our dual FTS5 & vector-enabled search engine indexes full document content, matching natural language concepts as well as exact keyword patterns.
kf_search_bullet_1: Local SQLite FTS5 index scans millions of words instantly
kf_search_bullet_2: Pinpoints exactly which pages and files match your query
kf_search_bullet_3: AI-assisted query expansion for synonyms and legal terms
kf_search_row1_desc: Fully optimized local SQLite FTS5 index pinpoints exactly which pages and files match your terms.
kf_search_row2_desc: Parses synonyms, legal terms, and contextual themes to expand your queries automatically.
kf_tags_desc: Enhance your files with custom taxonomy. Attach quick annotations, tags, notes, and priority marks directly to any document without modifying the underlying source files.
kf_tags_bullet_1: Persistent case notes and draft summaries attached to files
kf_tags_bullet_2: Custom tags like “Contracts” or “Urgent Review” for instant filtering
kf_tags_bullet_3: Nothing important gets buried in the folder tree
kf_tags_row1_desc: Add persistent case notes, descriptions, and review items to log guidelines or reminders.
kf_tags_row2_desc: Group cases or templates under shared tags for instant filtering.
kf_email_desc: Ascurix Desktop eliminates the chore of manual correspondence filing. By connecting your active mail client to the workspace, you can automatically ingest incoming legal queries and lock attachments to their corresponding files.
kf_email_bullet_1: Secure IMAP sync connects to your email account in the background
kf_email_bullet_2: Contextual matching maps correspondence to the right case
kf_email_bullet_3: Attachments download straight into the target case folder
kf_email_row1_desc: Connect directly to standard email providers via secure IMAP — no middleman or web portal.
kf_email_row2_desc: AI-driven parsing maps conversations to the correct case folder dynamically.
kf_tasks_desc: Stop rebuilding the same checklist for every new matter. Ascurix Desktop generates a case's task list from a reusable template the moment it's created, tracks each task's status, and rolls every case's tasks into one dashboard so nothing falls through the cracks.
kf_tasks_bullet_1: Templated checklists auto-generate tasks with due dates at case creation
kf_tasks_bullet_2: Review and tweak every generated task before the case is created
kf_tasks_bullet_3: A cross-case dashboard surfaces what's overdue or due today
kf_tasks_row1_desc: Define a task template once — every new case of that type auto-generates its task list with due dates.
kf_tasks_row2_desc: Retitle, redescribe, re-estimate, or drop any generated task before the case is actually created.
kf_tasks_row3_desc: Search and filter every task across your caseload, with urgent (overdue/due-today) items surfaced first.
kf_teams_desc: Ascurix isn't just for solo practitioners. Bring your whole firm onto one account: invite teammates, organize them into teams, and control who can manage what with role-based permissions — while every case file and document stays local to each person's own machine.
kf_teams_bullet_1: Invite teammates by email with a role and team assigned upfront
kf_teams_bullet_2: Role-based permissions (admin, manager, user) gate who can invite and manage
kf_teams_bullet_3: Organize your firm into teams, each with its own manager and roster
kf_teams_row1_desc: Invite by email with a role and, optionally, a team assigned at invite time — they set their own password.
kf_teams_row2_desc: Admins manage the whole firm; managers manage their own teams; users get read-only firm visibility.
kf_teams_row3_desc: A shared roster and team structure for your firm — case content itself never leaves each person's machine.
